sanskrit: svāhākṛtaḥ śucir deveṣu gharmo yo aśvinoś camaso devapānaḥ | tam u viśve amṛtāso juṣāṇā gandharvasya praty āsnā rihanti ||
english: Consecrated with svāhā, pure among the gods is the gharma-vessel, the divine drinking-cup of the two Aśvins. The immortal ones, all of them delighting in it, lick it to the face of the Gandharva.

sanskrit: sugā vo devāḥ sadanā kṛṇomi ya ātasthedaṃ savanaṃ juṣāṇāḥ | vahamānā bharamāṇā abhrā astaṃ gharmaṃ tam udātiṣṭhatānu ||
english: I make your abodes easy to reach, O gods, you who stand here delighting in this pressing. The clouds, bearing and carrying, set westward — arise accordingly after that gharma-vessel.

sanskrit: śivā naḥ śaṃtamā bhava sumṛḍīkā sarasvati | mā te yuyoma saṃdṛśaḥ ||
english: Be auspicious to us, most soothing, bestowing good comfort, O Sarasvatī. May we not be parted from your sight.

sanskrit: upainaṃ devo agrabhīc camasena bṛhaspatiḥ | yajamānāya śundhata indra gīrbhir na ā bhara ||
english: The divine Bṛhaspati seized it with a ladle. Purify it for the sacrificer; O Indra, bring it to us as with our hymns.

sanskrit: saṃ mā siñcantu maruta ity ekā ||
english: "Let the Maruts pour upon me" — so runs the single verse.

sanskrit: iḍaivāsmām̐ anu vastāṃ vratena yasyāḥ pade punate devayantaḥ | ghṛtapadī śakvarī somapṛṣṭh- -opa yajñam asthita vaiśvadevī ||
english: May Iḍā alone clothe us with her vow, she in whose footstep the god-seeking ones purify themselves — ghee-footed, great, soma-backed, she has stood near the sacrifice, belonging to all the gods.

sanskrit: drapsaś caskandety ekā ||
english: "The drop has spilled" — so runs the single verse.

sanskrit: yas te drapsa skandati yas te aṃśur bāhucyuto dhiṣaṇāyā upasthāt | adhvaryor vā pari yaḥ pavitrāt taṃ te juhomi manasā vaṣaṭkṛtam ||
english: Whatever drop of yours spills, whatever shoot of yours has fallen from the arm, from the lap of Dhiṣaṇā, or that which falls around the purifying-cloth of the adhvaryu priests — that I offer to you, made into an oblation by the mind.

sanskrit: drapsaḥ patito viśvayaḥ pariśrutaḥ | ayaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ saṃ taṃ siñcatu rādhase ||
english: A drop has fallen, universally known, renowned on all sides. May this divine Bṛhaspati pour it together for the bestowal of bounty.

sanskrit: yas te drapsaḥ patitaḥ pṛthivyāṃ dhānāsomaḥ parivāpaḥ karambhaḥ | ayaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ saṃ taṃ siñcatu varcase ||
english: Whatever drop of yours has fallen on the earth — the soma mixed with grain, the scattered offering, the gruel — may this divine Bṛhaspati pour it together for radiant splendor.

sanskrit: payasvatīr oṣadhayaḥ payasvan māmakaṃ vaca ity ekā ||
english: "The herbs are full of milk; full of milk be my word" — so runs the single verse.

sanskrit: ayam agnir vareṇya āyuṣ ṭe viśvato dadhat | punas tvā prāṇa āyati parā yakṣmaṃ suvāmi te ||
english: This Agni, most excellent, bestowing your lifespan from every side — your breath returns to you again; I drive away the wasting disease from you.

sanskrit: janād viśvajanīnaṃ viśām urukṣitīnām | dūrāt tvā manya ābhṛtam īrṣyāyā nāma bheṣajam ||
english: From among people, from among the universal folk, from the clans with wide dwelling-places — from afar do I consider this remedy named jealousy to have been brought.

sanskrit: dūrād etat saṃ bharant- -īrṣyāyā nāma bheṣajam | tat saṃvegasya bheṣajaṃ tad aśnā saṃgṛbhāyikam ||
english: Gathering this from afar — the remedy named jealousy — that is the cure for agitation; that is what grips and seizes like a stone.

sanskrit: agner iva dahato dāvasya dahato yathā | etām etasyerṣyāṃ hṛda udnāgnim iva vāraye ||
english: As of Agni burning, as of a forest-fire burning — thus I ward off this jealousy of his from the heart, like water wards off fire.

sanskrit: apa mārjmy apanayan manyuṃ te hṛdayād adhi | amuṣminn īrṣyām ā dadhmas tatro enāṃ ni dadhmasi ||
english: I wipe away, removing the anger from your heart. We place jealousy upon that one yonder; there upon him we set it down.

sanskrit: tiraścirājer asitāt pṛdākor adhi saṃbhṛtam | tat kaṅkaparvaṇo viṣam iyaṃ vīrud adūduṣat ||
english: Gathered from the spotted serpent, from the dark pṛdāku snake — the poison of that kaṅka-joint: this plant here has countered it.

sanskrit: iyaṃ vīrun madhujātā madhuścun madhulā madhu sā vihrutasya bheṣajy atho maśakajambhanī ||
english: This plant is honey-born, honey-dropping, full of honey — it is the remedy for the one who has been afflicted, and moreover a destroyer of mosquitoes.

sanskrit: yato daṣṭaṃ yataḥ pītaṃ tatas tvā nir ṇayāmasi | abhryasya tṛpradaṃśino maśakasyārasaṃ viṣam ||
english: Wherever bitten, wherever the venom was drunk — from there we lead it out of you: the insipid poison of the cloud-borne, deeply biting mosquito.

sanskrit: ayaṃ yo vikhyo vikaṭo viparvā mukhāny eṣāṃ vṛjinā kṛṇoṣi | tāni tvaṃ deva savitar iṣīkām iva saṃ namaḥ ||
english: This one who is notorious, terrifying, with disjointed limbs — you make the mouths of these crooked. Bend them down, O divine Savitṛ, like a reed stalk.

sanskrit: yad annam admi bahudhā virūpaṃ hiraṇyam aśvam uta gām ajām avim | yad eva kiṃ ca pratijagrahāham agniṣ ṭad viśvād agadaṃ kṛṇotu ||
english: Whatever manifold food of varied kinds I eat — gold, horse, cow, goat, sheep — whatever it may be that I have accepted: may Agni make all of that free from sickness.

sanskrit: yad āśasā me carato janām̐ anu yācamānasya vadato vicukṣubhe | yan me tanvo manaso viriṣṭaṃ sarasvatī tad ā pṛṇād ghṛtena ||
english: Whatever in me was shaken by hopeful expectation as I roamed among people begging and speaking — whatever in my body and mind was injured, may Sarasvatī fill that with ghee.

sanskrit: yad ārima pratigṛhṇanta enaḥ siṣāsanto balim agne carantaḥ | tvaṃ nas tasmād enaso mumugdhi vaiśvānaraḥ prati havyā gṛbhāya ||
english: Whatever sin we incurred as we went about seeking to win tribute and accepting offerings, O Agni — free us from that sin, O Vaiśvānara; receive in return the oblations.

sanskrit: cakṣuṣaḥ pāśān manasaś ca pāśād vīkṣāyāḥ pāśād uta śakvarīṇām | tasmān mumugdhi viśvāvaso tvaṃ no dātṝṇāṃ dānaṃ bhunajāmahai vayam ||
english: From the snares of the eye, and from the snares of the mind, from the snare of jealous gazing, and from the bonds of the powerful ones — from that free us, O Viśvāvasu, so that we may enjoy the gifts of the givers.

sanskrit: adur me viśve devā adāt savitedam | adān me brahmaṇaspatiḥ priyo mitro adād idam ||
english: All the gods have given to me; Savitṛ has given this. Brahmaṇaspati has given to me; the dear Mitra has given this.

sanskrit: indreṇa medinā yuj- -āpa bādhe pṛtanyataḥ | adhare santu śatravaḥ ||
english: Joined with Indra as my ally, I drive away those who fight against me. May the enemies be brought low.

sanskrit: agnir indraś ca yad yuvaṃ hato vṛtrāṇy aprati | ugrā hi vṛtrahantamā ||
english: When you two, Agni and Indra, have slain the obstructions without resistance — for you are the fierce ones most effective at slaying Vṛtra.

sanskrit: agnim indraṃ ca yad vayaṃ purodhāyai havāmahe | tau no mṛḍāta īdṛśe ||
english: When we invoke both Agni and Indra for the sake of priestly office, may those two show grace to us in such a situation.

sanskrit: yābhyāṃ svar ajayann agre yāv ātasthatur bhuvanā juṣāṇā | pracarṣaṇī vṛṣaṇā vajrabāhū agnim indraṃ vṛtrahaṇā huvema ||
english: Those two by whom the sun was won in the beginning, who have stood firm delighting in the worlds — the two wide-ranging, bull-like ones with the thunderbolt in their arms: we call upon Agni and Indra, slayers of Vṛtra.

sanskrit: yayor ojasā stabhitā rajāṃsi yau vīryair vīratamā śacībhiḥ | yau patyete apratītau sahobhir viṣṇum agan varuṇaṃ pūrvahūtiḥ ||
english: Those two by whose might the realms of space are propped up, who are most heroic in their heroic deeds and powers — those two who rule unresisted by their forces: a foremost invocation reaches Viṣṇu and Varuṇa.
